modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organize work as per the organization’s health, safety and security policies and procedures
identify the risks and hazards associated while driving and their causes and preventions
check and ensure the functioning of vehicle before commencing work
identify and report vehicle maintenance and repair requirements/risks as per SOP, if any
take corrective measures and follow standard first-aid procedures in case of an accident
ensure safety of all passengers and immediately report any breaches to the appropriate authority
ensure vehicle and equipment are regularly cleaned and sanitized
wash hands with soap and use alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose of PPEs regularly and appropriately
report hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority, if any
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify ways to optimize usage of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) in the vehicle
use resources in a responsible manner
check for spills/leakages in the vehicle with caution
plug spills/leakages of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG), oil/coolant or water from the vehicle and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of the vehicle
ensure the various equipment of the vehicle is properly connected

pcs.pc_description: report to duty on time as per the schedule
wear proper uniform and PPE like masks, gloves, etc. as per standards
follow duty closure procedure on completion of responsibilities for the day

modules.module_title: Perform basic check on the ambulance before the trip

pcs.pc_description: ensure the ambulance meets the basic legal and compliance requirements such as CMVR guidelines from MoRTH, guidelines issued by Road Transport Authorities (like RTOs, etc.), and other safety, security and environmental guidelines, etc.
check ambulance for any technical defects or immediate need for servicing like oil/filter change, coolant and fuel levels and tyre inflation levels, etc.
record all deviations observed while carrying out basic check of the ambulance
check oxygen level in the cylinder and ensure to get it refilled if it is empty
inspect stretcher for durability, physical damages, wheels locks, legs folding, etc.
ensure the equipment to be checked by a paramedic as per the checklist and type of ambulance (AIS125 document)
make sure the ventilator system and nebulizer is working properly as per standards and any other equipment, in case of an I.C.U. ambulance
check rescue equipment such as hammer, cutter, etc.

modules.module_title: Liase with the control room/authorised person

pcs.pc_description: inform the control room regarding the status of the previous journey on completion
obtain details of the pickup passenger and information of the route and current traffic condition from control room
inform the concerned person regarding the inability to reach the pickup point on time because of heavy traffic jams, vehicle breakdown etc. well in advance
close the call at the control room post dropping of the passenger as per duty closure and procedure
report vehicle defects to the supervisor to diagnose and resolve the problem, if any
inform superior about the road worthiness of ambulance and use another ambulance, if found unfit
inform the authorized person about incidents like accidents, breakdowns, minor altercation, etc. during the day, if any

pcs.pc_description: wear proper uniform and PPE like masks, gloves, etc. as per standards
use recommended sanitisers to clean the hands and ambulance area to maintain hygiene in ambulance
reach the patient's location and rescue the patient, if required in a scientific manner
confirm the patient’s name and transfer the patient safely on a stretcher and in the ambulance
follow proper safety guidelines like wearing a seat belt, keeping door windows closed, using inner and outer rear view mirrors and wearing PPE kit, etc.
make sure all the doors are closed/locked and all the equipment are fitted properly, as required
start the ambulance, switch on the siren and drive the ambulance as per driving standards
select the shortest route based on the distance and traffic conditions
pick the patient and drop to the hospital or at the desired destination
choose the destination route of the patient pickup and hospital/diagnostic center considering the traffic conditions and distance
start and adjust air conditioning/blower as per the requirement and coordinate with control room for another ambulance, in case of an emergency/breakdown/malfunction
pull out the patients on a stretcher with the help of an assistant or paramedic doctor after stopping the ambulance and reaching at the destination

modules.module_title: Conform to traffic regulation for ambulance driving

pcs.pc_description: switch on the siren while moving in traffic
use emergency lane for driving as per traffic norms
drive within the speed limit, keeping safe distance in relation to other vehicles/any emergency vehicles, ambulances ahead, behind or at the sides, etc.
make way for the ambulance by maintaining safe distance from other ambulance/vehicles in case of traffic jams
coordinate with a traffic control room in case of traffic jams/accidents/road blocks
follow rules, regulations and practices for handling general public issues
